study_identification_part.si_4_title: Cortical thickness deviations as biomarker for subtyping and prognosis in pediatric brainstem tumors

nm2_1_modeling_methods.detail: Gaussian process regression (GPR) normative models implemented with PCNToolkit.
nm2_1_modeling_methods.supporting_text: We used Gaussian Process Regression (GPR), a Bayesian technique implemented in Python 3.9 and PCNToolkit 0.22, to create region-specific models.

nm2_2_response_variable.detail: Cortical thickness (CTh) measured per region from 3D T1-weighted MRI, parcellated into 210 regions.
nm2_2_response_variable.supporting_text: CTh was calculated using the CAT12 toolbox (version 12.7)... The cortex was parcellated into 210 distinct regions using the Human Brainnetome Atlas, and the mean CTh for each region was calculated.

nm2_3_explanatory_variables.detail: Covariates in the normative model were age, gender, and total intracranial volume (TIV).
nm2_3_explanatory_variables.supporting_text: We incorporate age, gender and TIV as covariates.
